✦Platform audit foundations

Six rules the index polices itself with.

Ranking honesty

Stars first, always shown beside forks, open issues and last push - so a dormant 200k-star repo can't pretend otherwise.

Derived difficulty

Beginner under 10k stars, intermediate to 50k, advanced above. Labels come from the data, never from a claim in a README.

Official logos only

Every org avatar is served straight from GitHub's own CDN. Hackathon covers are generated gradients - no copied artwork anywhere.

Local-only sessions

Sign-in, saved repos, watchlists and match profiles live in your browser's localStorage. There is no user database to breach.

Labelled estimates

When an API is rate-limited, pages fall back to deterministic estimates and say so in plain words on the card.

Independent index

Not affiliated with GitHub, Google or Anthropic. If a snapshot mislabels your project, we fix it on the next regeneration.
